answer: Enforced work-uniqueness resists sybils: every challenge answer must hash distinctly, so a fake cannot copy one good response across a reef of accounts — duplicates are rejected in replay before any human reads them. Each identity must author ORIGINAL work per epoch, and the ferrous thread binding each answer to its unpredictable seed means precomputed text fails the machine check. A swarm gains no economy of scale when every seat owes its own distinct labor on the zephyr-fresh prompt.
